content:
[L] high | bottom of right panel | Copilot panel extends past the window bottom edge and is clipped mid-scroll with no visible scrollbar or composer below it — the suggested-reply block runs off-screen.
[L] high | window bottom | No reply/composer strip is visible anywhere; the reading pane is missing its primary action area, and the Copilot panel appears to occupy/collapse that region inconsistently.
[L] med | conversation list, "judy@example.com" row | Subject "#502 Joinnow data erasure request - fro..." is truncated with an ellipsis even though ample horizontal width remains in the list column.
[L] med | Copilot header | The "Local" label is overlapped/collided by a malformed glyph (crown/arrow artifact) directly on the text.
[L] med | search controls row | Search field, "#" chip, and Apply button sit on the same row but the Filters/Reset/Sync row below uses different spacing, leaving a ragged, unaligned control block.
[S] high | conversation list controls | Vertical gap between search row and Filters row differs from gap between Filters row and list, and the Apply button baseline does not align with the search input.
[S] med | conversation list rows | Row 1 and row 2 use different internal padding — row 1's "Closed" tag sits higher relative to "Unassigned" than row 2's, and metadata spacing is inconsistent.
[S] med | reading pane top | "1 past conversation on file" and "No similar past conversations found yet." float with uneven gaps and no grouping, unlike the carded Signals/Summary blocks above.
[S] low | views rail | "Views" caption and the All/Active/Pending/Closed items have inconsistent left insets versus the list column's header alignment.
[H] high | Copilot panel | Drafted-by disclaimer "[Drafted by SupportOS Copilot from past resolutions and help articles — review before sending.]" is rendered at the same size/weight as reply body text, mixing metadata with primary content.
[H] med | conversation list | Sender name, timestamp, subject, and status tag all compete at similar weights; "Unassigned" italic metadata reads louder than the subject hierarchy warrants.
[H] med | Signals/Summary | Section headings ("Signals", "Summary") are plain body-size text with no typographic differentiation from bullet content.
[H] low | Summary bullets | Bullet markers are inconsistent glyphs (• vs ?) and repeated duplicate line "How do I give them full access..." appears as both bullet and bare line, reading as debug output.
[C] high | whole screen | Three columns have no separators or shared grid — views rail, list, and Copilot panel float with uneven gutters, giving an unfinished prototype look.
[C] med | conversation list | Large dead whitespace below the second row while the right panel is overstuffed and clipped — density is badly unbalanced across columns.
[C] med | Copilot panel | Suggested-reply block is a full-bleed lavender slab with a stray left rule extending past its bounds, unlike the white cards above it — inconsistent card treatments.
[C] low | top of list column | "All" heading and "2 of 2 conversations" count sit close to the top edge with tighter inset than the Copilot panel's header, breaking shared top alignment.

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped panel, missing composer, collided glyphs, and no coherent grid make this read as a debug prototype, not a product.
